'As an additional cost to play Hungering Slaughterbeast, banish 3 random cards from your graveyard.' + printed **Blood Debt**. Shadow Brute Action - Attack (batch set label LeviaBlitzDeck).

BLOOD DEBT NOT AUTHORED: printed_keywords carries BloodDebt - a CR section 8 keyword on the card DB keywords field, implemented engine-side (ability_keywords.blood_debt); re-authoring it would be a defect.

COSTS ARE COSTS: 'as an additional cost to play' must be able to BLOCK the play, so it is a cost, never an ON_PLAY effect.

SHAPE - CARD LEVEL, NOT A COST-ONLY PLAY ABILITY: the cost is this card's ENTIRE printed behaviour, so it is authored as the top-level cost object with "abilities": []. A PLAY ability carrying only additional_cost and "effects": [] fails test_card_json_hygiene.test_every_ability_has_effects (tests/test_card_json_hygiene.py:248-257 asserts effects or modes or options), so that spelling is a hygiene defect by construction even though DSL_REFERENCE's Scrap snippet shows it. The hygiene test counts a card-level cost as implementation, and the engine path is verified in the loader this session: compile_card reads the top-level 'cost' dict through _compile_cost into CardDef.play_cost (loader.py:144-162), which play.py checks before offering the play and pays on application. Shape copied from .drafts/boneyard_marauder_blue.json / _red.json - Boneyard Marauder blue is the SAME LeviaBlitzDeck set with an identical first sentence.

COST TYPE: BANISH_RANDOM_FROM_GRAVEYARD (cost_types.py:192-224, read this session) takes exactly one parameter, amount (default 1): can_pay requires >= N cards in the controller's graveyard, so with fewer than 3 the play is not offered - correct for a MANDATORY additional cost; pay random.sample()s N cards ('random cards', not chosen) and banishes each via canonical banish(origin_zone='graveyard'), so they actually leave the graveyard rather than sitting in both zones. It also records what it banished under the shared banished_cards ref, which this card has no payoff to read but costs nothing.

No gaps.
